Your weekly rhythm

Before, during and after each class

Before class

  • Listen to the primer audio.
  • Take the 3-question readiness check.
  • Work the interactive lesson. It tells you right away when you are right.

In class

  • Follow the slides and worked examples.
  • Check your lab numbers with the lab checkpoints.
  • Submit your work in Brightspace as your instructor directs.

After class

  • Review with the toolkit, podcast and debate.
  • Retake the readiness check two days later.
  • Finish the lab take-home.
